artworks.title: Saint John on the Island of Patmos
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, blue, green, tan, gold, and red-orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a seated figure with a halo, along with a bird and an ethereal figure in the sky. The seated figure is interacting with an open book or scroll in a landscape setting with greenery and water. Beside them, a bird sits attentively. Above them in the sky, there is a radiant, haloed figure. The painting features vibrant greens, blues, and red colors. This artwork is reminiscent of medieval religious iconography or manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Saint Juliana
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, rose, brown, tan, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure standing over a defeated beast. The scene depicts a robed figure holding a staff standing over a creature in a lush green landscape. The painting employs a medieval style with stylized forms and flat colors, characteristic of illumination or early woodcut prints. The colors used are rich blues, greens, and reds against a pale background. The figure's posture suggests triumph, while the creature appears lifeless or submissive.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist and Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, pink, gray, brown, and tan
artworks.description: The image shows two panels with full-length figures. The left panel features a bearded man with long dark hair, standing upright and pointing with his right hand. He wears a ragged garment with a belt, holds a staff in his left hand, and a lamb rests on a book with a cross. A circular halo is behind his head. In the right panel, another bearded man with long hair wades through water, carrying a staff in his left hand. A child with a circular halo sits on his right shoulder, holding a globus cruciger in his right hand. The man wears a tunic tied with a sash and is barefoot, with his lower legs submerged in water. The background is simplistic, focusing on the figures and their attributes.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in gray, rose, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a side view, facing slightly left. The person has long hair, wears a crown, and has stylized facial features with prominent eyes and a defined jawline. They wear a grey cloak over a red garment, hold a staff in their left hand, and a small dragon-like creature is at their feet. The background is a light, textured surface.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, yellow, rose, orange, and blue
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with long, wavy hair, wearing a multi-layered robe in red and a lighter color. The person is holding a lamb in their left arm and a staff with a cross in their right hand. They have a halo above their head. The background has floral and leafy patterns in various colors, with a neutral inner background and green foreground around the feet.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, yellow, vermilion, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person, featuring their upper body and head. The person is depicted sitting or kneeling, leaning slightly to the side while holding a cross-staff. Their facial features are simple and stylized, with a gentle expression. They have blond hair that is depicted with wavy lines and part of their hair is covered by a round halo-like shape. The individual wears a long pink robe with blue sleeves. At their feet sits a small, spotted cat-like creature. The background includes a simple landscape with a path leading to a small building with a cross on top, and a few stylized trees, all outlined in black. The entire scene is enclosed within a yellow border.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, blue, brown, gold, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person dressed as an angel, positioned upright. They have blonde hair and serene facial expression, wearing a long red robe with a white hem. The angel has large ornate wings that are green with red borders, holding a balance scale with two pans. One pan contains a figure dressed in white with a red hat, and the other contains a smaller figure in a red and gray outfit. The angel also has a pink halo. The background includes green grass and blue horizontal stripes in the sky.

artworks.title: Saint Onuphrius
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in ochre, pink, gray, and red
artworks.dimensions:
image: 27.8 x 19.1 cm (10 15/16 x 7 1/2 in.)
sheet: 29.3 x 21 cm (11 9/16 x 8 1/4 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing with a slightly turned position, facing forward. He has long, curly hair and a full beard. He wears a crown with flower motifs and a halo. He is covered in a leafy garment and holds a staff and a circular object. An angelic figure with wings appears above his shoulder, holding a cross-emblazoned circle. Surrounding him are flourishing plants, and a scroll with text unfurls to his left. The background has abstract, golden plant-like elements.

artworks.title: Saint Onuphrius
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in tan, blue, green, red, gold, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling on the ground. They face left with long brown hair, a beard, sharply defined eyebrows and eyes, wearing a foliage-patterned garment. They hold a staff and an object. Above them, an angelic figure with wings and a red robe flies. The background features a landscape with hills, trees, a path, and a distant building under a blue sky. The image is within a red-bordered frame.

artworks.title: Saint Onuphrius
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, rose, brown, black, silver, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing barefoot. They have long brown hair and a beard, wearing a brown or tan garment. In their left hand, they hold a red cloth draped over a staff with a cross. The background has large green leaves. The scene is framed with a thin black border, with a bright blue stripe at the top and a green wave-like pattern at the bottom.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul with the Sudarium
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion, red-violet, rose, blue, green, brown, and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts two men holding a cloth between them. The man on the left has grey hair, a beard, and wears a red robe with a blue lining. The man on the right has brown hair, a beard, and wears a pink robe with a blue lining. The cloth they hold displays a face with long brown hair and a beard with drops on the forehead. In the background, there are two crossed keys behind a papal tiara. Archways frame the scene in the top corners.

artworks.title: Saint Poppo
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red and yellow; printed on vellum and retouched
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 10.3 x 6.8 cm (4 1/16 x 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body figure standing with a mitre on their head and a green fabric hanging from it. The person's eyes are closed with a calm expression, wearing a robe with red and white stripes and holding a crozier in their left hand. A smaller figure beside them is kneeling, wearing red and white clothing, with clasped hands. In the background are two figures near trees in a green landscape with hills. The scene is framed with a red border.

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, olive, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows two archers with bows and an individual tied to a tree. The first archer, on the left, wears a red jacket and a hat while aiming the bow. The second archer below wears red pants and a tunic with stripes. The person tied to the tree stands with a serene expression, a halo around their head, and shoulder-length wavy hair, partially clothed in a loincloth. They are shown standing next to a tree with large green leaves in a stylized greenery background.

artworks.title: Saint Sebaldus and Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, red, yellow, green, and orange

artworks.title: Saint Sebastian

artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 29.4 x 20 cm (11 9/16 x 7 7/8 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The artwork shows a man tied to a tree and pierced with arrows. He has curly golden hair and a halo above his head, suggesting he is a saint. He is wearing a loincloth and appears serene with closed eyes. Around him are an archer, a figure in a turban and robe, and another in a long robe holding a scepter. The background features a medieval town under a sky with golden rays. There is Latin text inscribed in the lower part of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Benedict
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, olive, yellow, androse
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. They are facing slightly to the right with their left hand placed on their chest and their right hand holding a gold crozier. The person has a solemn expression, fine facial features, and a distinctive tonsure hairstyle. They are dressed in a dark brown monk's robe that drapes to the ground. Below their left arm is a small ornate vessel with a leafy stem. The background features green hills, stylized flowers, and bushes against a beige sky with two stars visible. On the ground nearby is an ornate, gold miter.

artworks.title: The Voyage of Saint Ursula
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, green, blue, yellow, tan, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a small ship with figures aboard, engaging with a figure on land. The painting depicts a medieval-style ship with a large sail and is occupied by four figures, who are visibly engaging with another figure standing on land. The sea is painted in a series of horizontal lines in varying shades of blue, giving a sense of movement, while the background suggests a horizon with a simplistic landscape. The use of colors is bold, with reds, greens, and blues dominating the attire of the figures and the landscape. The framing of the image is decorative, with bright colors creating a border around the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Valentine
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, rose, and tan
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 13.4 x 9.5 cm (5 1/4 x 3 3/4 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 39.4 x 31.8 cm (15 1/2 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows three people standing over two more people who lay on the ground. On the left, a tall man stands facing the right. He wears long red robes over a white gown, and a tall white pointed hat with red details. There is a yellow halo around his head, and he holds a tall golden staff with a curved top. On the right, two shorter people turn towards him. A man in a green robe holds a yellow cross and a box or envelope, while a woman with blonde hair and a red dress holds a chicken. Above them, several yellow crosses and other objects hang from a yellow bar. By their feet, two people with blonde hair lay on the ground, their eyes closed. All of the people in the print have light orange skin. A pig and a cat-like animal also stand on the ground. By the pig, in the bottom left corner, is a shield with a heraldic symbol that includes three crescent moons. The colorful red, green, orange, and yellow pigments have been applied imprecisely within the bold, black outlines of the print, so many areas of paint are patchy, with the off-white paper beneath showing through.

artworks.title: The Mass of Saint Gregory
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, yellow, tan, brown
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a religious setting. One figure is emerging from a tomb-like structure and is raising both hands. This person has distinct facial features, wears a crown of thorns and a halo, and has dark hair. On the left, a person in a tall hat and red robe kneels near a multicolored altar while holding an open book. On the right, an angelic figure with large red wings and a halo stands beside the kneeling person with hands held in front. The background features a stone wall, an altar, hanging items, and an ornate ceiling. The scene is colorful and includes green, red, yellow surfaces, and text blocks at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, yellow, and brown [fragment]
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure crucified on a cross. The central figure has arms outstretched horizontally, hair and beard depicted simply, and is wearing a loincloth. Surrounding the figure are other individuals, some wearing blue and red robes, and some with covered heads. One character on the right holds an object resembling a staff with a flag. They stand on a grassy-looking ground, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Four Martyrs - Saint Acacius
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in yellow, green, red, and tan-gray
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a group of figures with golden halos in repose. The style is reminiscent of medieval woodcut illustrations, with simplified anatomy and thick dark outlines. The figures are set against a background of solid colors like green and yellow.

artworks.title: Holy Kinship
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, yellow, red lake, and light brown
artworks.dimensions:
image: 26.5 x 38.9 cm (10 7/16 x 15 5/16 in.)
sheet: 26.7 x 39.1 cm (10 1/2 x 15 3/8 in.)
overall (exterior frame dimensions): 44.8 x 60 cm (17 5/8 x 23 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows multiple individuals arranged in a religious scene. At the center stands a crowned woman with long hair holding an infant. She is dressed in a red and green robe. Behind her are lines suggesting veneration. To her left and right are figures with halos, dressed in colorful robes. Some individuals are crowned. Decorative scrolls with ancient-style script are present. The background is light.

artworks.title: The Sacred Monogram
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand coloring in orange-red and gray-blue on laid paper
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. The central focus is a detailed portrayal of Christ on the cross with the letters "INRI" above. Surrounding the crucifix are symbolic elements including a chalice at the base collecting blood from Christ's body. Flanking the cross are large ornately decorated letters "IHS." Implements associated with the Passion such as dice, a whip, and a lance are also present.
Two kneeling figures are depicted on either side of the cross, accompanied by textual banners. The image is framed by a decorative border.

artworks.title: Purgatory
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, red lake, green, yellow, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of an angel reaching down to figures enveloped in flames. The image portrays an angelic figure extending a hand toward a group of anguished figures in a fiery setting. The figures show expressions of distress, with some hands clasped in gestures of supplication. The background is minimal, focusing on the interaction and the contrast between the flames and the angel's attire. This artwork is done in the style of medieval religious iconography.
